info.name: Razorpay Bills Invoices API
info.description:
Razorpay payment gateway APIs for accepting payments, managing orders, processing refunds, payouts, and subscriptions. All amounts are in the smallest currency sub-unit (e.g. paise for INR). Supports 180+ payment methods including UPI, cards, netbanking, wallets, and EMI.

Contact Support:
 Name: Razorpay Support
 Email: support@razorpay.com

request.description: Create an invoice or payment page. Set type='invoice' for a formal invoice or type='link' for a simple payment page. The invoice is created in draft state; call POST /invoices/{id}/issue to send it to the customer. Cannot be used to create GST invoices (use the Dashboard for those). Maximum 50 line items per invoice.

response.name: Invoice created in draft state.
